title: Agent connections
description: GET /connections (hlm connection list): OAuth connections approved on the phone, newest first.

clientName.description: The client's own name (self-asserted), also the actorName of its changes

clientType.description: cimd: identified by a metadata document from clientHost; dcr: registered itself (values may be added)

clientHost.description: Host of the client's metadata document; null for a client that registered itself

redirectHost.description: Where the authorization went back to: claude.ai, localhost or 127.0.0.1

items.description: tasks:read or tasks:write (values may be added)

lastUsedAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds, updated at most every 10 minutes

expiresAt.description: When the current refresh token expires (Unix ms); unused connections end then
